build._doc: Wrap every *.json in src/data/ as a globalThis.PORTAL_DATA[<key>] companion (data-*.json.js). Engine: front-data-json-js-wrapper.sh.

Generates every real independent page (home, sections, suite cloud/phone x quickmarks/all, content-section subpages) from src/data/cloud-mobile.json. Runs after sass/esbuild so generated pages can reference the real style.css/script.js paths; the shell template registers the service worker itself (see main.ts) rather than relying on the sw_register injector, since that mod only targets a fixed file list and this project has dozens of generated pages at varying depths.
MUST run last — hashes the dist artifacts above to derive BUILD_HASH and inject it into the SW bundle.
